title: Let CLAUDE_CODE_CONTEXT_LIMIT set the context window for any model
description: The resolver already reads CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS, but only honours it for models that pass an eligibility check — everything else falls through to the 200000 default. This adds an unconditional short-circuit at the top of the resolver, under a separate variable name so the official one keeps its meaning.

sites.description: The context-window resolver: takes (model, context), returns 1e6 early for the long-context cases, and ends at the default constant. Identified by reading CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS and returning 1e6 — the other two functions mentioning that variable take zero and three parameters respectively. Arity is kept at 2 only as a tiebreaker; the 1e6 return is the real signal.

verify.describe: resolver short-circuits on the env var
